tickets.title: Build retirement income plan
tickets.text: Create a revised monthly retirement income plan for Evelyn Lanternmoss following Adrian Lanternmoss’s death. Reflect the lost $2,840 monthly pension payment, Evelyn’s part-time wages of about $38,000 annually, available cash reserves, the $2,150 monthly mortgage payment, Social Security timing options, and potential withdrawals from taxable and retirement accounts. Document assumptions, identify planning gaps, and prepare recommendations for advisor review.

subTasks.title: Gather retirement income inputs
subTasks.text: Collect current spending targets, anticipated retirement timing, pension or Social Security estimates, account types, cash reserves, recurring liabilities, and known major upcoming expenses.

subTasks.title: Model withdrawal and tax sequencing
subTasks.text: Compare withdrawal order options across taxable, tax-deferred, and tax-free accounts. Note estimated tax brackets, required minimum distribution considerations, and cash-flow timing tradeoffs.

subTasks.title: Stress-test plan assumptions
subTasks.text: Evaluate the plan under lower return, higher inflation, longer longevity, and unexpected expense scenarios. Flag assumptions that materially change the recommendation.

subTasks.title: Prepare advisor summary
subTasks.text: Summarize recommended income sources, annual review triggers, tax-aware implementation steps, and open questions for client discussion.

tickets.title: Request insurance policy review materials
tickets.text:
Outreach recipient: Evelyn Lanternmoss
Policy type: life

Message outline:
Hello Evelyn Lanternmoss,

We are reviewing Adrian Lanternmoss’s insurance coverage as part of his survivor benefit planning. Please provide the following claim forms and evidence required for Adrian’s Buttonwood Balloon Insurance term policy and Clockwork Clover Railworks group life benefit:
- Current policy declaration page or policy summary
- Premium amount and payment frequency
- Coverage amount, riders, exclusions, and ownership details
- Beneficiary information, if applicable
- Cash value, loan balance, or surrender value, if applicable
- In-force illustration or current projection, if applicable
- Any pending changes, lapses, or underwriting updates
- Claim forms and supporting evidence required for the benefit claims

Please let us know if a specific authorization form is needed before releasing information.

Thank you,
Apricot Compass Advisory
